Info.About: AGC overhead-light thermal equations with source-grounded crop-area to floor-area normalization
Info.Status: calibration replay; fixed area conversion, not fitted to climate error
Info.Topology: HPS and LED are separate overhead sources; GreenLight interlighting is not used
Info.Parameter provenance: initial LED thermal seeds mirror Katzin-2021 LED toplights and are not AGC measurements
Info.Area normalization: Published crop-growing area 76.8 m2 divided by compartment floor area 96 m2 = 0.8. GreenLight energy balances are per floor area.

tCovIn.definition: (1/capCovIn) * (hTopCovIn + lTopCovIn + rCanCovIn + rFlrCovIn + rPipeCovIn + rThScrCovIn - hCovInCovE + rBlScrCovIn + rLampCovIn + rIntLampCovIn + rLedCovIn)
tCovIn.description: Internal cover temperature with overhead LED longwave exchange

tBlScr.definition: (1/capBlScr) * (hAirBlScr + lAirBlScr + rCanBlScr + rFlrBlScr + rPipeBlScr - hBlScrTop - rBlScrCovIn - rBlScrSky - rBlScrThScr + rLampBlScr + rIntLampBlScr + rLedBlScr)
tBlScr.description: Blackout-screen temperature with overhead LED exchange

tThScr.definition: (1/capThScr) * (hAirThScr + lAirThScr + rCanThScr + rFlrThScr + rPipeThScr - hThScrTop - rThScrCovIn - rThScrSky + rBlScrThScr + rLampThScr + rIntLampThScr + rLedThScr)
tThScr.description: Thermal-screen temperature with overhead LED exchange

tAir.definition: (1/capAir) * (hCanAir + hPadAir - hAirMech + hPipeAir + hPasAir + hBlowAir + rGlobSunAir - hAirFlr - hAirThScr - hAirOut - hAirTop - hAirOutPad - lAirFog - hAirBlScr + hLampAir + rLampAir + hGroPipeAir + hIntLampAir + rIntLampAir + hLedAir + rLedAir)
tAir.description: Main-air temperature with overhead LED convection and shortwave absorption

tCan.definition: (1/capCan) * (rParSunCan + rNirSunCan + rPipeCan - hCanAir - lCanAir - rCanCovIn - rCanFlr - rCanSky - rCanThScr - rCanBlScr + rParLampCan + rNirLampCan + rFirLampCan + rGroPipeCan + rParIntLampCan + rNirIntLampCan + rFirIntLampCan + rParLedCan + rNirLedCan + rFirLedCan)
tCan.description: Canopy temperature with overhead LED radiation

tPipe.definition: 1 / capPipe * (hBoilPipe + hIndPipe + hGeoPipe - rPipeSky - rPipeCovIn - rPipeCan - rPipeFlr - rPipeThScr - hPipeAir - rPipeBlScr + rLampPipe + rIntLampPipe + rLedPipe + hBufHotPipe)
tPipe.description: Rail-pipe temperature with overhead LED exchange

tFlr.definition: (1/capFlr) * (hAirFlr + rParSunFlr + rNirSunFlr + rCanFlr + rPipeFlr - hFlrSo1 - rFlrCovIn - rFlrSky - rFlrThScr - rFlrBlScr + rParLampFlr + rNirLampFlr + rFirLampFlr + rParIntLampFlr + rNirIntLampFlr + rFirIntLampFlr + rParLedFlr + rNirLedFlr + rFirLedFlr)
tFlr.description: Floor temperature with overhead LED radiation

tLed.definition: (1/capLed) * ((agcGrowingToFloorArea*qLedProcessed) - rLedSky - rLedCovIn - rLedThScr - rLedBlScr - hLedAir - rParLedCan - rNirLedCan - rFirLedCan - rLedPipe - rParLedFlr - rNirLedFlr - rFirLedFlr - rLedAir - hLedCool)
tLed.description: Effective temperature of the overhead ELIXIA fixture layer

qLampIn.description: HPS electrical input from the explicit AGC accounting driver

rParGhLed.description: Effective LED PAR above the canopy

rParLedCanDown.description: LED PAR directly absorbed by canopy

rParLedFlrCanUp.description: Floor-reflected LED PAR absorbed by canopy

rParLedCan.description: Total LED PAR absorbed by canopy

rNirLedCan.description: LED non-PAR shortwave absorbed by canopy

rNirLedFlr.description: LED non-PAR shortwave absorbed by floor

rLedAir.definition: rParGhLed + rNirGhLed - rParLedCan - rNirLedCan - rParLedFlr - rNirLedFlr
rLedAir.description: LED shortwave absorbed by greenhouse air

parLedCan.description: LED PAR photons absorbed by canopy

rParCan.description: Total PAR above and outside canopy including overhead LED

rCanLed.description: Shortwave radiation above canopy from overhead LED

rCan.description: Global radiation above canopy including overhead LED

parCan.description: Total canopy-absorbed PAR photons including overhead LED

hLedCool.description: LED heat actively removed from greenhouse

zetaLedPar.description: Effective LED PAR photons per joule of PAR; calibration seed

capLed.description: Effective LED fixture heat capacity; calibration seed

aLed.description: Effective overhead LED area; calibration seed

etaLedCool.description: Fraction of LED input actively removed; calibration seed

agcGrowingToFloorArea.description: Published 76.8 m2 crop-growing area divided by 96 m2 floor area; fixed source conversion
